blocks.text: Master the Grill – Loyalty Campaign for MOL Hungary
Campaign

In summer 2025, with our support, MOL Hungary launched a nationwide loyalty campaign to energize customer engagement and drive higher spending among MOL Move members.
Branded “Master the Grill – For MOL Move Members Only” , the campaign offered exclusive access to a premium BBQ product collection from Italian kitchenware leader PINTINOX . With strong seasonal appeal and a practical, reward-driven mechanic, the initiative activated 370 petrol stations across Hungary over an 11-week period, seamlessly combining digital convenience with real-world value.
The campaign aimed to increase usage of the MOL Move app , reward loyal customers, and reinforce the brand’s position as an innovator in customer loyalty.
Collection Overview

The PINTINOX BBQ Collection was more than just a set of products — it was a full summer experience packed into 13 carefully selected items. Each product offered MOL Move members a tangible lifestyle upgrade, combining outdoor utility with elegant Italian design.
To bring more relevance and emotional connection, the collection was grouped into three key clusters:
🔥 Grill Like a Pro Designed for serious BBQ enthusiasts, this set of tools turned any garden cookout into a masterclass. Durable, heavy-duty, and built for performance, these items brought professional-level precision to the backyard. – Cast Iron Grill Pan – Ideal for searing steaks with perfect grill marks. – Cast Iron Pan – Versatile and robust, perfect for open flame cooking. – BBQ Tool Kit – Everything you need for flipping, grilling, and serving like a chef. – BBQ Gloves – Heat-resistant and practical for safe grilling. – Carving Set (2 pcs) – Sharp, sleek, and made for flawless slicing. – Steak Knife Set (4 pcs) – Perfect for sharing grilled perfection with friends and family.
🧊 Cool, Carry & Enjoy This cluster focused on convenience and outdoor comfort, enabling members to easily transport, store, and enjoy their BBQ moments — wherever summer took them. – Picnic Blanket – Soft, compact, and ready for spontaneous outdoor meals. – Thermic Bag (Cooler Bag) – Keeps drinks and ingredients chilled and fresh. – Thermo Tumbler – Ideal for hot coffee or iced drinks, all day long. – Hip Flask – Sleek and discreet, for a celebratory sip in nature.
🏕️ Adventure-Ready Essentials Whether camping, hiking, or just exploring beyond the backyard, these rugged tools were built for the outdoors — compact, multifunctional, and tough enough for any journey. – Pro Axe – Durable and sharp, ideal for wood prep and outdoor tasks. – Pro Machete – A bold tool for clearing space and cutting with ease. – 9-in-1 Knife – Compact utility in your pocket — screwdriver, opener, blade and more.
Mechanics

The campaign was powered by a digital stamp collection mechanic integrated into the MOL Move mobile application.
How it worked:
Customers received 1 digital stamp for every HUF 4,000 spent at participating MOL stations (fuel, shop products, or services).
Stamps were automatically credited to the user’s MOL Move app when their loyalty card was scanned.
Once 5 stamps were collected, they could be exchanged in the app for a digital coupon , which granted access to one of the PINTINOX products at a special promotional price .
Coupons were redeemable at any of the 370 participating stations across the country.
Accepted payment methods included cash, bank card, or eligible MOL fuel cards (single method only per transaction). Mixed payment with fuel card + cash was not permitted.
This seamless process encouraged repeat visits and elevated spend, while increasing digital engagement through the MOL Move app.

details.campaignTitle: Inspired by Space. Ready for Every Journey.

The 50-litre Duffle Bag 2-in-1 could be carried as either a traditional travel bag or a backpack. Made from durable rPET fabric, it also featured water-resistant zips, reflective details and the ZipClip system to help protect customers’ belongings. For everyday journeys by car, the 800 ml Thermo Tumbler was designed to fit conveniently into a vehicle and included a practical handle and straw. Campaign communication highlighted temperature retention of up to six hours for hot drinks and eight hours for cold drinks. Across the bag collection, recycled rPET fabric supported a more responsible material choice while maintaining the durability required for regular travel. summary: Intermarché’s “Travel Like a Champion” campaign turned everyday shopping into an engaging loyalty journey. details.campaignTitle: TRAVEL LIKE A CHAMPION WITH ORACLE RED BULL RACING
details.challenge:
Adrenaline of collecting stickers and unlocking discounts. A strong loyalty campaign does more than offer a lower price. It transforms everyday purchases into visible progress towards a reward customers genuinely want. For Intermarché Poland, KLR created “Travel Like a Champion”—a sticker-based loyalty campaign featuring a limited collection of Oracle Red Bull Racing travel and lifestyle products. The campaign combined a simple promotional mechanic, a highly recognisable international brand and a practical assortment designed for everyday journeys.

The reward assortment translated the energy, performance and distinctive style of Oracle Red Bull Racing into a coherent collection of 13 functional travel products.

Travel & Mobility Essentials — designed for seamless movement and smart packing: Cabin Trolley, Check-in Trolley, Carry-on Backpack, Travel Pillow. Bags & Everyday Gear — stylish and functional companions for daily use or short trips: Urban Backpack, Duffle Bag, Shoulder Bag, Ladies’ Backpack, Ladies’ Bag, Reversible Umbrella. Food & Drink On-the-Go — for staying refreshed and prepared wherever the journey leads: Water Flask, Thermo Bottle, Thermo Food Jar.

The Challenge. The objective was to encourage customers to consolidate more of their regular grocery purchases within the Intermarché network. At the same time, the reward proposition had to be attractive enough to maintain interest throughout the campaign and motivate customers to complete their collector’s cards.
mechanics: A simple path from purchase to reward. Customers received promotional stickers for qualifying purchases at participating Intermarché stores. Customers earned: one sticker for every PLN 50 spent in-store; some additional products are given for the purchase of selected partner products. The key element of the campaign was the use of extra stickers on selected partner products. This mechanic helped drive sales for participating brands while giving the retailer access to additional partner investment, which could be used to strengthen promotional visibility and increase the campaign’s overall reach and impact. After collecting 10 stickers on a collector’s card, the customer could purchase one selected product from the promotional collection at a significantly reduced price. Collector’s cards were available in Intermarché stores and could also be downloaded and printed from the dedicated campaign website. Promotional products could be purchased until 31 July 2026, while stocks lasted.

Lottery. To further strengthen customer engagement, Intermarché complemented the sticker campaign with a promotional lottery running from 23 March to 3 June 2026. For every PLN 70 spent, customers received a unique code and the chance to win 1 of 1000 shopping vouchers or the ultimate prize: 1 of 8 tickets to attend the 2026 Spanish Formula 1 Grand Prix at MADRING in Madrid. By combining accessible instant participation with a highly aspirational final reward, the lottery helped encourage higher basket values, generate excitement and build momentum ahead of the main loyalty campaign.

The campaign journey connected supermarkets, checkout communication, printed collector’s materials, social media and a dedicated website. At every stage, customers received a clear message: shop, collect, choose and save. The straightforward mechanic minimised barriers to participation, while the online campaign hub provided easy access to the collector’s card, product information, frequently asked questions and the full promotional terms.
